title: Self-Distilled RLVR

key_results: RLSD achieves higher convergence ceiling and superior training stability compared to pure RLVR or on-policy self-distillation

hypotheses.hypothesis: On-policy self-distillation alone provides stable learning signals for LLMs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combining self-distillation for magnitudes with RLVR for directions improves training

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complex memory mechanisms are necessary for strong streaming video understanding
hypotheses.result: Refuted: simple sliding-window baseline matches published methods

hypotheses.hypothesis: Value of longer context increases uniformly with model scale
hypotheses.result: Refuted: context benefit is backbone-dependent

title: Two-dimensional materials for integrated sensing
task: Two-dimensional materials for integrated optoelectronic sensing and information encoding
key_results: 2D materials enable tunable, multi-dimensional optical information encoding in MAC operations; integrated sensor architectures overcome electrical-optical dimensional mismatch; framework unifies single and multi-dimensional signal processing
comments: The review synthesizes emerging opportunities in 2D-material-based sensors but would benefit from specific performance benchmarks comparing to conventional approaches.

model_io.model: 2D material-based integrated sensor with resistive-switching and optical coupling

hypotheses.hypothesis: 2D materials' tunable properties enable integrated encoding of multi-dimensional optical information
hypotheses.result: Promising; architecture and material selection remain under active development

title: Quantum ground-state cooling of two librational modes of a nanorotor
task: Ground-state cooling of nanorotor librational modes
key_results: Cooled two orthogonal librational modes of SiO2 nanoparticles to quantum ground state; achieved angular precision better than 20 µrad
comments: Coherent cavity-scattering approach enables simultaneous cooling of multiple rotational degrees of freedom, paving the way for quantum sensing applications.

model_io.model: Optically levitated SiO2 nanoparticle in high-finesse cavity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coherent scattering enables ground-state cooling of librational modes
hypotheses.result: Successfully demonstrated; achieved near zero-point fluctuations

title: Structural, physical, and elastic properties of α-Fe2O3 nanoparticles doped on borate glasses
task: Structural, elastic, and optical properties of α-Fe2O3 nanoparticle-doped borate glasses
key_results: Indirect optical bandgap decreased from 3.138 to 2.36 eV with Fe2O3 loading; elastic moduli decreased; structural compaction evidenced by density increase and molar volume decrease; refractive index and optical basicity enhanced
comments: Systematic characterization reveals Fe2O3 acts both as a network modifier and optical dopant, with complex competing effects on mechanical and electronic properties.

model_io.model: Borate glass with variable α-Fe2O3 nanoparticle doping (0–2 mol%)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fe2O3 incorporation reduces optical bandgap and decreases elastic moduli
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; observed systematic trends with increasing doping

title: Giant-magnetocaloric effect and phonon dynamics in (GdCe)CrO3
task: Magnetocaloric and phonon dynamics in Ce-doped GdCrO3 perovskite
key_results: Giant magnetic entropy change ΔSM ~ 40–45 J/kg·K (90–70 kOe, 3 K); spin-flip transition reorientation from Γ4 to Γ4′; pronounced spin-phonon coupling via A1g(6) mode
comments: The exceptionally large magnetocaloric effect rivals best rare-earth materials, driven by delicate spin-orbit and Zeeman coupling interplay.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ce3+ substitution enhances magnetocaloric effect via spin-reorientation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; largest ΔSM observed among rare-earth orthochromites

title: A tri-linear quantum dot architecture for semiconductor spin qubits
task: Scalable semiconductor spin qubit architecture via tri-linear quantum dot array
key_results: Tri-linear array provides equivalent or superior connectivity to 2D square lattices; medium-scale shuttling arrays (tens of microns) could enable million-qubit systems; 3D integration with cryoCMOS control demonstrated
comments: Leveraging standard CMOS fabrication for quantum dot arrays is pragmatic, though electron shuttling fidelity and crosstalk remain critical challenges.

model_io.model: Tri-linear quantum dot array with electron shuttling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tri-linear geometry with shuttling provides scalable qubit connectivity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; connectivity matches or exceeds 2D arrays with simpler wiring

title: X-ray and γ-ray beam interstellar communication and implications for SETI
task: X-ray and γ-ray beam interstellar communication and SETI signal detection
key_results: High time-resolution detector can distinguish artificial (OOK-modulated) signals from random noise via relative entropy; signal detection remains robust despite dead-time/rise-time smearing (>10× pulse duration)
comments: The information-theoretic approach to SETI signal detection is rigorous, though actual alien civilizations may employ encoding schemes radically different from human digital formats.

model_io.model: X-ray/γ-ray detector simulator with OOK modulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Relative entropy clearly distinguishes artificial from random signals despite detector smearing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; clear separation observed even with rise-time > pulse duration

title: Operational deflection shape measurements on rotating bladed disks with tracking continuous-scanning LDV
task: Operational deflection shape measurement of rotating bladed disks using tracking continuous-scanning LDV
key_results: Tracking continuous-scanning LDV achieved full-field ODS reconstruction with modal assurance criterion (MAC) = 0.98; seamless multi-blade measurement at 120 r/min and higher speeds; non-contact continuous scanning validated
comments: The phase-offset strategy enabling seamless blade-to-blade transitions is a practical advance for real-time monitoring of rotating machinery.

model_io.model: Tracking continuous-scanning LDV system with multi-beam setup

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synchronized laser tracking enables accurate ODS reconstruction in rotation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MAC = 0.98 matches FEM predictions

title: Analysis and research on iron loss of multi-layer interior permanent magnet synchronous motor for electric vehicle applications
task: Iron loss optimization in interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) via rotor geometry
key_results: Proposed three-layer I2V rotor type reduces total harmonic distortion (THD) by 27.2% vs. V-type; iron loss significantly lower, especially under deep flux weakening; experimental validation shows good FEA agreement
comments: The orthogonal decomposition model for iron loss calculation combined with advanced rotor geometry offers practical pathways for EV motor efficiency improvement.

model_io.model: IPMSM with variable rotor structures (V, IV, I2V types)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Three-layer I2V rotor improves sine-degree of air gap flux, reducing iron loss
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; I2V shows lowest THD (27.2% reduction) and iron loss vs. comparators

title: Optimizing the heating performance of Trombe walls with ribbed surfaces using three-dimensional CFD analysis
task: Thermal enhancement of Trombe walls with ribbed surfaces via 3D CFD optimization
key_results: Rib density Nr = 5 with appropriate geometry increases Nusselt number by 68.3% (Re = 1600); triangular ribs yield highest thermal gain (99.4% Nu increase) but high friction penalty; semi-circular ribs optimize trade-off (TEF = 1.51)
comments: The parametric study clearly demonstrates that optimal rib design requires balancing heat transfer enhancement against pressure drop, with semi-circular geometry offering practical efficiency for nZEB applications.

model_io.model: 3D Trombe wall with ribbed channel (ANSYS Fluent, laminar Re = 600–1600)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ribbed surfaces enhance Trombe wall performance; optimal geometry balances thermal and friction effects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Nr = 5 with semi-circular ribs achieves TEF = 1.51

title: High temperature thermoelectric energy conversion in half metallic Cs2MBr6 double perovskites M=Mn, Mo, Ta, Ir from first principles
task: High-temperature thermoelectric properties of half-metallic double perovskites Cs2MBr6
key_results: Half-metallic ferromagnetism (100% spin polarization) confirmed for all compositions; Seebeck coefficient 400–1000 μV/K at room temperature; ZT ≈ 0.83–0.99 (300–1000 K); exceptional thermostability
comments: The combination of robust half-metallicity with high thermoelectric efficiency is rare and offers promising prospects for spin-based energy conversion devices.

model_io.model: Cs2MBr6 double perovskites (M = Mn, Mo, Ta, Ir) DFT calculations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spin-selective transport in half-metals yields high thermoelectric performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ZT ≈ 0.83–0.99 achieved via large spin-dependent band gaps

title: Revealing the transient ionization dynamics and mode-coupling mechanisms of helicon discharge through a self-consistent multiphysics model
task: Transient ionization and mode-coupling in helicon plasma discharge
key_results: Rapid density rise within ~10−4 s with two-peak electron temperature structure; RF energy redistribution characterized during ignition; sensitivity revealed to gas pressure, magnetic field, and driving frequency
comments: The fully coupled multiphysics model provides predictive insights into RF plasma dynamics, though computational cost may limit real-time optimization applications.

model_io.model: Self-consistent helicon discharge model (COMSOL: Maxwell + energy transport + kinetics + chemistry)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transient ionization involves two-stage RF energy redistribution and mode coupling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; localized energy deposition followed by field restructuring observed

title: Systematically exploring yeast metabolism through retrobiosynthesis and deep learning
task: Systematic exploration and reconstruction of yeast underground metabolism
key_results: Yeast-MetaTwin model reconstructed with 16,244 metabolites, 1,976 genes, 59,865 reactions; experimental validation of geraniol-to-geranial conversion pathway
comments: Combining retrobiosynthesis with deep learning is pragmatic for gap-filling, but prediction accuracy on novel enzymatic reactions remains to be systematically benchmarked.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Underground metabolism encodes systematic differences in substrate affinities (Km) compared to known pathways
hypotheses.result: Km distributions differ between known and underground networks; hub metabolites identified

hypotheses.hypothesis: Predicted genes participate in geraniol biosynthesis via geranial intermediate
hypotheses.result: Two genes experimentally validated for geraniol-to-geranial conversion
